intro.title: Build a todo list CRUD app in JavaScript
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple, interactive todo list application using plain JavaScript. You'll learn how to implement CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations to manage your tasks. The core programming concepts include using arrays to store tasks, DOM manipulation to display and update the UI, and event handling for user interactions. You'll work with fundamental JavaScript constructs like functions, loops, and conditionals to create a fully functional app from scratch.
intro.usecase: The CRUD operations you'll build in this todo list are the foundation of nearly every interactive web application. You see this pattern in e-commerce product management dashboards where admins create, read, update, and delete items, in project management tools like Trello for managing task cards, and in content management systems for editing articles or user profiles. Mastering this pattern is essential for any developer building forms, data tables, or dynamic lists that require persistent user interaction.
